mentions.name: Haven Terminal
mentions.description: Haven Terminal is a native Mac app that acts as a modern tmux replacement, letting users manage agents and terminal sessions across multiple machines in a single UI.
mentions.problem: Managing agents and terminal sessions across several machines in separate places creates cognitive load.
mentions.audience: Managing agents and terminal sessions across several machines in separate places creates cognitive load.
mentions.source_excerpt: A native Mac app as a modern tmux replacement.  I manage agents and terminal sessions across several GPU machines and having it all in one UI has been great for reducing cognitive load.

evidence.value: A native Mac app as a modern tmux replacement.  I manage agents and terminal sessions across several GPU machines and having it all in one UI has been great for reducing cognitive load.
